project_name: Vetaura - Clinical AI Scribe & Practice Copilot

design_philosophy.fusion_statement: Combining Swiss clinical data density with warm botanical sage tones and reassuring veterinary warmth — removing cognitive fatigue for veterinarians while honoring the human-animal bond.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Calm, intensely reliable, empathetic, high-velocity clinical precision
forbidden_patterns: No generic AI purple or violent neon gradients (#7351B7 is forbidden)
No generic Inter/Roboto for headings (use Fraunces / Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit)
No cold sterile hospital cyan/pure blue-white aesthetic
No emoji icons (🤖🧠💭💡) for clinical features
No transparent dropdown/popover menus without solid/crystal backdrop

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first approach. Mobile viewports (under 768px) stack all multi-column clinical views into clean single-column cards with bottom navigation bar or collapsible sheet drawers.

layout.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom bar on mobile with 4 main touch points: Queue/Dashboard, Ambient Scribe, Patients, Inbox/Alerts + Top brand bar with staff switcher.
layout.tablet_desktop: Left expandable sidebar with full sub-navigation, multi-pane split editors for SOAP note generation alongside patient longitudinal histories and lab trend charts.

typography.headings_scaling: h1: text-2xl on mobile -> text-4xl on desktop; h2: text-xl on mobile -> text-2xl on desktop
typography.form_inputs: min-h-[44px] text-base on mobile to avoid auto-zoom triggers, with clear tap zones.

responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure all table views have responsive horizontal scroll containers (overflow-x-auto) and all long clinical SOAP fields wrap with break-words.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons and interactive patient pills minimum 44x44px bounding hit area.

capabilities: Live audio recording interface with realistic simulated or mic audio stream via Whisper API
Dual audio options: Live Mic recorder with waveform + Quick pre-recorded sample consultation selector (e.g. 'Canine Dermatology visit', 'Senior Feline Renal check', 'Post-Op Cruciate Ligament')
One-click Claude Sonnet 5 SOAP generation (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) with structured editable sections
Confidence highlights + vet sign-off status with audit trail timestamp
Instant copy, export to PDF/PIMS format, or forward to client discharge
Owner & Pet profile with species icons, breed, age, spayed/neutered tag, microchip ID
Weight tracking timeline with Interactive Recharts visualization
Vaccination status badges (Core vs Non-Core, Overdue alerts in terracotta red)
Chronological visit histories with attached signed SOAPs and diagnostic summaries
Interactive Differential Diagnosis Checklist based on Signalment + Presenting Complaint + Exam Findings
Rule-in / Rule-out confidence rating tags (Likely, Secondary, Rare/Red-flag)
Recommended diagnostic workup (Blood chemistry, Ultrasound, Urinalysis, Cytology)
Smart visit templates picker: Wellness, Dermatology, Dental, Lameness, Euthanasia, Post-Op
Interactive panel showing Renal (BUN, Creatinine, SDMA), Liver (ALT, ALKP), Glucose, Electrolytes
Out-of-range visual alerts with reference brackets
Longitudinal charts over time with multi-point curves (e.g. 6-month renal monitoring for CKD stages)
Automated plain-language client instructions translated from clinical SOAP notes
Multilingual selector: English, Spanish (Español), French (Français), Mandarin (中文), German (Deutsch)
Medication schedule cards with dosage, frequency, and 'give with food' pictograms
Warning signs trigger checklist ('Call clinic immediately if...')
Client message inbox with urgency tagging (Urgent, Routine, Prescription Refill, Post-Op Check)
AI-suggested empathetic responses with Vet approval button
Shift-change / Case handoff summary generator aggregating all hospitalized and high-risk patients for the incoming night or day team
Daily appointment schedule with room allocations, appointment type pills, and ambient scribe quick-launch
Clinic KPI analytics: Note completion time saved, active patient counts, triage turnaround rate

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts Fraunces & Plus Jakarta Sans in index.html or index.css to give the app a distinct high-end botanical-clinical look.
Ensure the entire app is 100% responsive: on mobile devices, use drawer sheets or bottom navigation so veterinarians can walk between exam rooms with an iPad or smartphone.

Always provide realistic, rich mock data for veterinary cases (e.g. 'Bella - 7yo Golden Retriever - Itchy ears & paws', 'Milo - 12yo Domestic Shorthair - Elevated Creatinine/SDMA', 'Luna - 3yo French Bulldog - Grade 2 Patellar Luxation').
Integrate seamless toggle between live mic capture and sample audio cases so the user can test instant AI transcription + Claude SOAP generation without requiring real mic permissions immediately.
Implement full MongoDB CRUD backend endpoints in FastAPI with JWT staff auth + Emergent Google SSO mock support.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, tabs, and key metrics as required for automated validation.
Keep color palette grounded in Botanical Forest Greens (#236349, #2f7d5c), Soft Sage (#f0f4ef), and Warm Amber (#d97706) for alerts. Never use AI generic neon purple!

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.typography_rules: Use Fraunces serif for main headings and modal titles, Plus Jakarta Sans for UI labels and body, JetBrains Mono for clinical lab values and patient IDs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_rules: Never use dark color gradients. Hover states must have higher contrast with explicit text color definitions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for all save, transcribe, sign-off, and send actions with rich clinical confirmation messages.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive triggers and informational badges must have descriptive kebab-case data-testid tags.
